en: Welcome to the Trainers' School! Our pupils learn everything from type matchups to held items.
You're a trainer already, I can tell. Here, a little something for your Pokémon to hold.
A Pokémon holding a Quick Claw will sometimes get to move first, however slow it is. Isn't that clever?
Hmm? Oh, don't mind me. I'm just watching the young trainers here. I'm always looking for talent.
You look like you've got some yourself. I'll be keeping an eye on you!
